instructions:
1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place a towel under your right foot.
2. Slide your right foot behind and across your left leg, bending both knees to lower into a curtsy lunge.
3. Keep your front knee in line with your front ankle and your chest tall.
4. Push through your left heel and slide your right foot back to the start.
5. Finish all reps on one side, switch the towel to the other foot.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move slowly and with control to keep balance.
2. Keep your front knee tracking over your foot.
3. Push through your heel to drive the glutes.
4. Use a smooth floor so the towel slides freely.

instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place a resistance band under your left foot.
2. Hold the band with both hands at shoulder height or by your sides.
3. Step your right leg behind and across your left leg, bending both knees to lower into a lunge.
4. Push through your left heel to return to the start, bringing your right leg back to center.
5. Finish all reps, then switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your chest up and back straight.
2. Move slowly and with control against the band.
3. Exhale as you push up, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep tension on the band the whole rep.

instructions:
1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips or by your sides.
2. Step your right leg behind and across your left leg, bending both knees to lower.
3. Keep your front knee in line with your front ankle and point your back knee toward the floor.
4. Push through your left heel to return to the start.
5. Repeat on the other side, stepping your left leg behind your right, alternating sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move slowly and with control to keep balance.
2. Keep your front knee tracking over your foot.
3. Push through your heel to drive the glutes.
4. Keep your torso upright throughout.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your arms extended straight up toward the ceiling.
2. Lift your legs with your knees bent at 90 degrees.
3. Brace your core and slowly lower your right arm and left leg toward the floor, keeping your back flat.
4. Return your right arm and left leg to the start.
5. Repeat with your left arm and right leg, alternating sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your core braced and your lower back pressed into the floor.
2. Stop the limbs just above the floor to keep tension.
3. Move slowly so your back does not arch.
4. Breathe out as you extend, in as you return.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your right arm extended overhead on the floor and your left arm by your side.
2. Bend your right knee toward your chest and extend your left leg out, keeping both lower legs near parallel to the floor.
3. Brace your core and switch: sweep your right arm to your side while extending your right leg past hip level.
4. At the same time sweep your left arm overhead and draw your left knee toward your chest.
5. Keep your lower back flat and continue alternating sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your core braced so your lower back stays flat.
2. Stop the moving leg just above the floor to keep tension.
3. Breathe out as you extend, in as you return.
4. Use a mat to support your back.
